deviations: Fleet dot colour: WI §2 asks for a per-fleet dot in the fleet's OWN primaryColorHex, but AdminFleetDto (GET /admin/fleets) carries NO primaryColorHex and it is not on FleetHealthRow either. Fabricating a hex would invent tenant data and break the no-new-hex rule. Degraded to the ink dot (var(--ink)) for every row — consistent with the design's 'admin is unbranded, ink dot' principle. API-lane dependency: add primaryColorHex to AdminFleetDto for a true per-fleet dot later.

Fleets table data join: the WI columns (drivers, rides/month, 12-week sparkline, trend/health) exist ONLY on FleetHealthRow via useAdminAnalytics, NOT on AdminFleetDto. AdminFleetsPage now calls BOTH hooks (both left untouched): rows come from useAdminFleets.items (authoritative, drives total/active summary), enriched by joining useAdminAnalytics on fleetId. Fleets with no analytics row render 0 drivers / 0 rides / empty sparkline / inactive band.

Settings control rendered as a styled(Link) (xs outline look) instead of <DeskButton as={Link}>: DeskButtonProps has no polymorphic `as` prop (tsc TS2322), so DeskButton cannot render an <a>. The link keeps role=link + href=/admin/fleets/:id/settings + focus ring, matching the xs outline desk style via CSS vars.
Pre-create warning Callout omitted pending an i18n key (see i18n_requests); success callout carries the 'shown once' warning meanwhile.
notes: Restyled the SuperAdmin shell + login + fleets page onto @/shared/ui/desk, reusing the committed unbranded AppHeader (props prop-drilled from AdminGuard). Only additive coexistence (desk kit + CSS vars); no new hardcoded hex/magic px. useAdminFleets/useCreateFleet/useAdminLogin/useAdminAnalytics/createFleetForm/adminLoginForm/adminRoleGating/sparklinePath/healthBand all untouched. Health->pill-tone map and health->sparkline-stroke rule are small explicit local maps (colorToken from healthBand is a theme key, not a DeskPillTone). No memoization: the fleetId->health lookup Map is built inline per render (handful of fleets, no measured re-render problem) per rules/web-performance.md#memoization-policy. No customer phone numbers anywhere in /admin (privacy §4). AdminTenantSettingsPage.tsx and PlatformScreen.tsx untouched (WI-8). No api/, board, orders, or app files modified; locale JSONs and web/e2e/** untouched.
